component.name: Tabs
component.description: Tabbed navigation component with configurable orientation and variant styles.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Tabs container that owns tab selection and panel rendering.

slots.name: list
slots.description: Tablist that contains all tab triggers and the selection indicator.

slots.name: indicator
slots.description: Moving indicator aligned with the active tab trigger.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Tab button users activate to select a panel.

slots.name: leading
slots.description: Optional icon rendered before a tab label.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Text or custom label rendered inside a tab trigger.

slots.name: trailing
slots.description: Optional trailing content rendered after a tab label.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Tab panel rendered for the selected item.

own.name: activationMode
own.description: Whether keyboard navigation activates the tab immediately or waits for confirmation.

own.name: defaultValue
own.description: Default active tab value for uncontrolled usage.

own.name: disabled
own.description: Whether the tab list is disabled.

own.name: id
own.description: Unique identifier for the tabs root element.

own.name: keyboardLoop
own.description: Whether arrow-key navigation wraps from the ends.

own.name: onChange
own.description: Callback when the active tab changes.

own.name: orientation
own.description: The orientation of the tab list.

props.name: class
props.description: Custom class for the tab content panel.

props.name: content
props.description: Content to display when the tab is active.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon to display next to the label.

props.name: label
props.description: Label to display on the tab trigger.

item.description: An individual tab in the tabs component.
